title: Cute Smiling Baby in Backyard Swing, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming square black-and-white snapshot featuring a happy baby seated in a suspended fabric and metal porch or tree swing. The infant smiles delightfully toward the camera with bare feet dangling above a lawn bordered tree well. The print has characteristic mid-century scalloped edges, evoking the post-war suburban family life and baby boom era of the 1950s.
